notes: CelesTrak is the orbit source for satellites and debris.
UCS is used only to enrich/classify satellites, not debris.
Debris objects usually do not have UCS metadata because UCS tracks operational satellites.
Raw CelesTrak GP records are preserved under raw_celestrak_gp for traceability.
Mass enrichment added by ChatGPT on 2026-05-04: mass_kg is filled from UCS when available, otherwise from public spacecraft references or clearly marked estimates.
Use mass_source and mass_confidence. Low-confidence engineering_estimate values are placeholders for simulation realism, not authoritative spacecraft specifications.
